title: What the Vampire Squid keeps

is_this_you.pressure: Trouble comes and you sink below it. Whatever was hunting you is left snapping at a blue glow.
is_this_you.love: You remember the small thing they let fall three winters ago, and you still have it.
is_this_you.cost: You live so far down that the people who love you give up asking the way.

opener.text: Vilém Flusser and Louis Bec wrote a fable about this animal, part treatise and part spoof [s14]. In it the vampire squid is our counterpart, banished down into the abyss while we were banished up onto the continents [s14]. You were born a Pisces in a Rat year, and you have always lived a little upside down. What others call the bottom feels like home.

howto: Three parts. Let each one sink before the next.

tabs.label: Below the light
tabs.intro: Water on Water, both halves pointing down.

rows.text: Pisces is mutable Water, the sign of Jupiter and, for modern astrologers, Neptune [s1]. It is compassionate and intuitive [s1] [s2]. The Rat is yang Water, quick-witted and observant, and careful enough to be suspicious [s4] [s5]. So you are Water twice. One half lets everything in. The other half counts it.

The vampire squid lives in the oxygen minimum zone, mostly 600 to 1,200 metres down, where oxygen falls to about 0.4 millilitres per litre [s9] [s7]. It thrives there [s7]. Water that thin is where your breathing finally slows.

Carl Chun named it Vampyroteuthis infernalis in 1903, roughly the vampire squid from hell [s13]. The name came from its dark colour and webbed cloak, and has nothing to do with its diet [s13]. People hear your name and brace. Then they meet you.

tabs.label: What drifts down
tabs.intro: Marine snow, and a long, patient line.

rows.text: Hoving and Robison call it primarily a detritivore, feeding in a way unlike any other cephalopod [s7]. It lets out a sticky filament up to eight times its body length and gathers what sinks past [s7] [s6]. You live the same way. You keep what others let fall, and you know what every scrap is worth.
Archives and salvage suit you. So does translation, where you shape what others made and your own hand stays hidden.
The Rat can be stingy [s5], and Pisces can slide into escape [s1] [s2]. Together you can sit on a store of things long after it could have fed anyone. Send one parcel up while it still helps.

tabs.label: Who finds you in the dark
tabs.intro: Three who will make the trip down. One who lives in the wind.
tabs.love_lead: In love you hold every detail and say very little about what you need. The Rat can feel unsure in love [s5]. You need someone steady enough to come down and stay. Tradition sends three who will make that dive.

easy.why: The Humpback Whale (Cancer, Dragon year) shares your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and Cancer is Water like you [s3] [s1].
The Dumbo Octopus (Pisces, Monkey year) closes the trine through the Monkey and swims under your own sign [s3].
The Asian Elephant (Cancer, Ox year) is your secret friend, since the Ox and the Rat are a Six Harmonies pair, and Cancer shares your Water [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The Avocet (Virgo, Horse year) pulls against you: the Horse clashes with the Rat, and Virgo is the sign opposite Pisces [s3] [s1].

story.text: The vampire squid has no ink [s6]. Disturb it and it lets off a cloud of glowing particles from its arm tips [s8] [s9]. In the 2003 study the cloud glowed for two to three minutes, and single particles lasted up to nine [s9]. The hunter bites the light. The squid has already drifted off.

closing: Leave a soft light where you were. Whoever follows it down will find you gentle.
